title: No maxPrice slippage on mint
severity_rationale: Downgraded from M-05. Rising price is intended design. No sell mechanism for sandwich. The 'front-runner' is just another legitimate minter. This is a UX feature request.
description: No slippage protection on mint(). MEV searcher front-runs to force victim to pay higher price.
impact: Users overpay for NFTs due to front-running
recommendation: Add maxPrice parameter to mint() for slippage protection
root_cause: No slippage protection parameter on mint function
